context: Fictional example only. The Community Energy Dashboard shows daily electricity use in a community center. It uses manually entered meter readings. It has no personal accounts. No energy savings have been measured. The prototype is for a demonstration, not a deployed product.

chunks.title: Purpose and electricity use
chunks.text: The Community Energy Dashboard shows daily electricity use in a community center using manually entered meter readings.

chunks.title: Limitations and measured savings
chunks.text: No energy savings have been measured. This is a demonstration prototype, not a deployed product. Data entry is manual.

chunks.title: Privacy and personal data
chunks.text: The fictional prototype stores aggregate meter readings, has no personal accounts, and does not collect occupant names.

faq.title: Project purpose
faq.question: What is the purpose of this project?
faq.questionZh: 这个项目的目的是什么？
faq.answer: The dashboard helps a community center see its daily electricity use. It uses manually entered meter readings, so people can discuss usage patterns. This is a fictional demonstration, not a deployed product.

faq.title: Limitations
faq.question: What are the limitations?
faq.answer: The prototype relies on manual data entry. It has not been deployed or evaluated, and no energy savings have been measured. We should treat it as a demonstration of how readings could be displayed.

faq.title: Privacy
faq.question: Does it collect personal data?
faq.answer: The fictional prototype uses aggregate meter readings and has no personal accounts. It does not collect occupant names. These statements describe the sample project only.
